Tests VM syscall memory and log operations under direct mapping and input region cases.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for `fd_vm_syscall` behavior in the VM. It creates a `fd_vm_t` instance, sets up VM memory regions, and then runs a series of checks for syscall functions such as `fd_vm_syscall_sol_memset`, `fd_vm_syscall_sol_memcpy`, `fd_vm_syscall_sol_memmove`, `fd_vm_syscall_sol_memcmp`, `fd_vm_syscall_sol_log`, `fd_vm_syscall_sol_log_64`, and `fd_vm_syscall_sol_log_data`. The tests verify correct return values, error codes, memory writes, overlap handling, access checks for read-only and writable regions, and log output content.

The file also tests the VM under both direct mapping disabled and enabled by changing feature state in [`test_vm_syscall_toggle_direct_mapping`](<#test_vm_syscall_toggle_direct_mapping>). It uses helper functions to fill memory with known patterns, compare host and VM memory, and check log collector state. At the end, [`dump_syscall_table`](<#dump_syscall_table>) registers all syscalls and prints the syscall table, so the file also serves as a validation point for syscall registration in the VM.
